title: Teamspace use cases
scope: Synthetic workspace: administrator, member, and visitor goals.
assumptions: Illustrative model; no application repository was analyzed.
Actor arrows show triggering goals; numbered scenario flows show ordered behavior.
Error handling stays inside scenarios and does not imply UML extend relationships.

invite.name: Invite a user
invite.trigger: Choose “Invite user” and submit an email and role.
invite.pre: Signed in; permission to manage users.
invite.success: A pending invitation is sent; access starts after acceptance.

scenarios.name: New team member
scenarios.condition: Valid email; person has no workspace membership.
scenarios.result: A pending invitation is sent; access starts after acceptance.

scenarios.name: Already a member
scenarios.condition: The email belongs to a current member.
scenarios.result: Show existing membership; do not create a duplicate invitation.

scenarios.name: Invalid email
scenarios.condition: The submitted address fails email validation.
scenarios.result: Show a validation message; keep the invitation form available for correction.

scenarios.name: Email delivery fails
scenarios.condition: The invitation is stored but the email service fails.
scenarios.result: Keep the invitation pending; show that delivery failed.

scenarios.name: Retry invitation delivery
scenarios.condition: A pending invitation exists; email delivery is available again.
scenarios.result: The invitation email is delivered; membership still requires acceptance.
scenarios.trigger: Choose Resend for the pending invitation.

roles.name: Change a role
roles.trigger: Select a member and confirm their new role.
roles.pre: Permission to manage users; an eligible member exists.
roles.success: The member receives the permissions of the new role.

scenarios.name: Eligible member
scenarios.condition: The selected member can receive the target role.
scenarios.result: The member receives the permissions of the new role.

scenarios.name: Last administrator
scenarios.condition: The role change would remove the last administrator.
scenarios.result: Block the change; keep the existing role and explain the restriction.

scenarios.name: Cancel role change
scenarios.condition: The administrator cancels before confirmation.
scenarios.result: Keep the current role.

suspend.name: Suspend access
suspend.trigger: Select a member and confirm suspension.
suspend.pre: Permission to manage users; the member can be suspended.
suspend.success: The selected member’s workspace access is suspended.

scenarios.name: Suspend a member
scenarios.condition: The selected account is eligible for suspension.
scenarios.result: The selected member’s workspace access is suspended.

scenarios.name: Protected administrator
scenarios.condition: The selected account is the last administrator.
scenarios.result: Block suspension; keep the account active.

scenarios.name: Cancel suspension
scenarios.condition: The administrator cancels before confirmation.
scenarios.result: Keep the member’s existing access.

rename.name: Rename workspace
rename.trigger: Enter a new workspace name and save.
rename.success: The new workspace name is visible to members.

scenarios.name: Successful request
scenarios.condition: All required information and permissions are valid.
scenarios.result: The new workspace name is visible to members.

scenarios.name: Invalid information
scenarios.condition: One or more supplied values cannot be accepted.
scenarios.result: Explain the validation issue; preserve the input for correction.

scenarios.name: Service unavailable
scenarios.condition: A required service is temporarily unavailable.
scenarios.result: Show a recoverable error; keep the request available for retry.

scenarios.name: Retry request
scenarios.condition: The required service is available again.
scenarios.result: The new workspace name is visible to members.
scenarios.trigger: Choose Retry for the failed request.

scenarios.trigger: Choose Forgot password and submit the account email.
